stem: The museum kept all three galleries open to visitors ______ the renovation work that its trustees had scheduled to close them for most of the spring.
______ the review panel having rejected its first two proposals, the consulting firm won the contract with a third bid that met every requirement in the tender.
Waiting times at the clinic fell sharply in May ______ hiring two temporary receptionists for the front desk cleared the backlog of unanswered calls within three weeks.
______ a fault in the cooling system that technicians first detected during the January shutdown, daily output at the main plant has been held to roughly four-fifths of capacity.
The two agents assigned to the gate must stay at the podium ______ passengers who need wheelchair assistance are boarding, and they may leave only when the lead agent releases them.
______ the quarterly audit, when every production system is frozen and access is limited to the security team, no engineer may deploy updates to the payment servers.
The customs broker asked to see the original invoices ______ the warehouse supervisor, who had been on leave since the previous Monday, had a chance to compare them with the manifest.
______ the wedding reception that the hotel hosts every Saturday evening has ended, kitchen staff reset the banquet room in time for the Sunday brunch service.
The bank cannot reverse a wire transfer ______ the sender whose account was debited in error has submitted a signed recall request within twenty-four hours.
A refund will not be issued ______ repairing the damaged unit proves impossible, since the retailer's policy is to repair a product before replacing it.
______ mortgage applications at the bank's urban branches rose by 14 percent last year, those at its rural branches fell for the third year in a row.
The report found that moving the printing plant would cost a fifth more over five years. ______, the board voted to move, citing the lower rents expected from the third year onward.
Please return the signed loan agreement to the museum registrar by Friday; ______, the painting will be sent back to its owner at the end of the month.
The registrar's office spread the enrollment appointments over four days ______ the online portal, which was rebuilt over the summer, would not be overloaded on the first morning.
The help desk received ______ detailed feedback from the pilot group of forty clerks that it rewrote the entire onboarding guide before the rollout.
Ms. Aldana, who has not yet decided whether she will make the trip, will receive no credit for her non-refundable ticket ______ she cancels more than a month in advance.
The organizers have already booked a second, smaller room at the hotel ______ more than two hundred delegates register, although only about a hundred and fifty have done so to date.
The bank will keep the promotional rate on the savings account in place for twelve months ______ the balance never falls below the minimum shown in the product guide.
